exposure: time to surgery (> 48 h after the onset of the symptoms)
outcome: Need for respiratory support in infants
cohort: Pregnant women with a history of BS referred with acute abdominal pain suspected for a bariatric complication
finding: Acute abdominal pain in pregnant women with a history of BS may be related to a bariatric complication, highlighting the need for awareness and timely referral to specialized care to prevent diagnostic delay and improve maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Two women underwent an emergency caesarean section shortly after the surgery due to foetal distress.
